The '''wedding''' of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]] and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[D'Wopp]] took place on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="TBT" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The members of [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] bartender [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]] were among the attendees. In a brawl following the formal ceremony, Valarian [[Death/Legends|killed]] her new husband because he had shown a lack of respect for her by accepting a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of their wedding.<ref name="TBT" />
